clue.text: Suitable cut-out for computer

definitions.note: the definition is a kind of computer

indicators.note: the word for cut sits outside, round the word for suitable

parts.note: to lop is to cut off
apt means suitable

explanation.surface: Something fit to be cut out to serve as a computer.
explanation.definitionFit: A portable machine small enough to rest on your knees is one type of personal computer.

clue.text: A letter I composed is well expressed

indicators.note: composed means put together anew, so the letters of these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A letter I wrote turns out to be nicely worded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composed' looks like the act of writing the letter, but it rearranges A LETTER I.
explanation.definitionFit: Writing that shows skill and education reads fluently, the bookish sense of the adjective.

clue.text: Fatherly friend swallows a tear

indicators.note: swallows means the word for friend takes in the other pieces

parts.note: a pal is a friend
a rent is a tear or rip

explanation.surface: A dad's mate gulps back a teardrop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tear' reads as a teardrop but is a rip, RENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Behaviour like a father's is behaviour of a mother or father, a synonym.

clue.text: It appears we have the responsibility

definitions.text: It appears we have the responsibility

parts.words: It appears we have the responsibility
parts.note: read as one word it is the burden itself

explanation.surface: Apparently the duty now falls to us.
explanation.definitionFit: A burden or duty is the weight of responsibility someone carries.

clue.text: The problem of race

parts.note: the surface hints at social questions; really it means a hurdle in a race, as in the comic school sports event with nets and barrels

explanation.surface: A social issue about ethnicity.
explanation.definitionFit: A hurdle or barrier is a problem in the way, and an assault-course style event bears that name.

clue.text: Bosom pals bid for a dangerous job

indicators.note: the fodder is offered in exchange for the answer, the loose signal that its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Close friends bid against each other for a risky post.
explanation.walkthrough: The indicator is only 'for': BOSOM PALS BID is exchanged for its rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Defusing and removing explosives is hazardous work done by army specialists.

clue.text: Cultivate a field-there's money in it

definitions.meaning: a shop's cash drawer holds money

explanation.surface: Farm a field, since it will pay.
explanation.definitionFit: Ploughing ground is a farmer's work, and a cash register drawer in a shop holds takings.

clue.text: Animal that's shy up to a point

parts.note: coy means shy

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word to is read from bottom to top

parts.note: E (east) is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A beast that is timid only to some extent.
explanation.definitionFit: The North American prairie wolf is a wild member of the dog family.

clue.text: Is ecstatic being a new parent

indicators.note: new tells us the word parent is made over into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone is overjoyed at becoming a mother or father for the first time.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone carried away with delight is rapt, in a state of rapture.

clue.text: American sent back in Jack's and Paul's place

indicators.note: the word for American is sent to the back, placed after the sailor's piece

parts.note: Jack is a sailor, a tar, and 's adds S

explanation.surface: A Yank is shipped home to a sailor's and an apostle's town.
explanation.walkthrough: St Paul came from Tarsus, in modern Turkey.
explanation.definitionFit: The apostle was born in that city of Cilicia, so it is his home town.

clue.text: One has a job to get money from one

definitions.text: One has a job to get money from one

parts.words: One has a job to get money from one
parts.note: a worker draws wages from the boss who hires them

explanation.surface: A worker is paid by someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A boss or company hiring staff pays their wages.

clue.text: A copper ring

parts.note: copper means a police officer, and the ring is a cordon of them rather than a band of metal

explanation.surface: A ring made of copper metal.
explanation.definitionFit: A line of officers encircling a scene keeps the public out.

clue.text: Old character will come quickly to the point

parts.note: to run is to come quickly
E (east) is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: An old-timer gets straight to the point without delay.
explanation.definitionFit: A letter of the ancient Germanic alphabet was an early written symbol.

clue.text: Merchandise one may come up with

definitions.meaning: to come up with the merchandise is the idiom for delivering what was promised

explanation.surface: Wares that someone might produce.
explanation.definitionFit: Stock for sale is a trader's wares, and 'deliver the wares' is the idiom of the second sense.

clue.text: Stay and return the tankards

indicators.note: return means the word for tankards is read backwards

parts.note: pots are drinking tankards

explanation.surface: Linger at the pub and bring the mugs back.
explanation.definitionFit: To remain or stay put is to halt, a synonym.

clue.text: Point to organist's control in bar

parts.note: E (east) is a point of the compass
a stop is a knob on an organ controlling a set of pipes

explanation.surface: Directing someone to the organ player's switch in a pub.
explanation.walkthrough: ESTOP is a legal term: to bar a party from asserting something.
explanation.definitionFit: In law, to preclude someone from going back on their word is to prevent or prohibit them.

clue.text: Used by a bowman leading Don Quixote's horse

indicators.note: only the leading part of the horse's name is kept

parts.note: the knight's old nag in Cervantes is Rosinante

explanation.surface: An archer guiding the nag of Cervantes's knight.
explanation.walkthrough: The bowman is a violinist, not an archer: resin is rubbed on the bow hairs.
explanation.definitionFit: String players rub resin on bow hair for grip, so a violinist uses it.

clue.text: Conveyance in one's car

definitions.meaning: the act of sending or carrying
the gearbox of a motor vehicle

explanation.surface: Being carried along while sitting in your vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: Broadcasting or sending is passing on, and a car's gearbox carries power to the wheels.

clue.text: Approve 'the head's portrait

parts.note: to like is to approve of
a ness is a headland, a head of land

explanation.surface: Signing off the headteacher's painted picture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head' is not the head teacher but a headland: NESS, as in Loch Ness or Dungeness.
explanation.definitionFit: A painting or image that resembles its subject is a picture of them.

clue.text: Access to transport

definitions.meaning: to delight or carry away emotionally

explanation.surface: Getting at the means of travel.
explanation.definitionFit: A doorway is a way in, and to charm or enrapture is to spellbind.

clue.text: North or South, it's the best place to start from

definitions.text: North or South, it's the best place to start from

parts.words: North or South, it's the best place to start from
parts.note: a polar spot either end of the globe is jokingly offered as the front slot on a motor race grid

explanation.surface: Explorers debate which end of the Earth to set off from.
explanation.definitionFit: In motor racing, the front spot on the starting grid is the prime place to begin.

clue.text: The fashion trade

explanation.surface: The clothing industry.
explanation.definitionFit: A habit or usual practice is a convention, and patronage of a shop is its business.

clue.text: Angelic turn of phrase

definitions.note: the definition is an adjective standing for a noun, an angelic being

indicators.note: a turn of the word phrase gives its letters a new order

explanation.surface: A heavenly way with words.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the highest order of angels is a celestial being.

clue.text: We object to journalist being employed

parts.note: us is the object form of we
ED is short for editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: We protest at a reporter being given work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'object' is grammar, not protest: US is the object case of WE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something put to work has been utilised, a synonym.

clue.text: Like a point to concentrate on!

definitions.text: Like a point to concentrate on!

parts.words: Like a point to concentrate on!
parts.note: a point of attention for the eyes, as in optics where light converges

explanation.surface: Something worth fixing attention on.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to a focus, where rays meet or attention centres, is the adjective's sense.

clue.text: Look for an equal

explanation.surface: Searching for someone on one's own level.
explanation.definitionFit: To squint closely is to gaze, and someone of the same standing is a match.

clue.text: Raised one's voice in righteous anger

indicators.note: in tells us the letters sit inside the words righteous anger

explanation.surface: Shouted out in justified fury.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Raised one's voice' suggests shouting, but here it means singing.
explanation.definitionFit: To produce a melody vocally is to lift the voice in song.

clue.text: It's a rum drink

indicators.note: rum means odd or strange, so the letters of it's a are mixed up

explanation.surface: An offering of a spirit made from sugar cane.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rum' is not the spirit but means odd, rearranging ITSA.
explanation.definitionFit: A sparkling Italian wine from Piedmont is an alcoholic beverage.

clue.text: Its contents goes to pot

parts.note: going to pot usually means ruin, but here the leaves literally go into the teapot

explanation.surface: Everything inside it is falling apart.
explanation.definitionFit: A small box for keeping leaves before brewing holds what is put into the teapot.

clue.text: Behind, like, with rent? That's awkward

parts.note: as means like

indicators.note: awkward means the word rent is put clumsily into a new order

explanation.surface: A grumble about being in arrears on rent.
explanation.definitionFit: Toward the back of a ship is the nautical word for at the rear.

clue.text: Many a creature seen in a wood

indicators.note: seen in means the creature's word appears inside the word many

parts.note: taken as written, then split open
a hog is a pig, a creature

explanation.surface: Lots of animals spotted in a forest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Many a creature' looks like a phrase about lots of animals, but 'a' pairs with 'creature', and 'seen in' puts that pair inside the first word.
explanation.definitionFit: A reddish-brown tropical hardwood prized for furniture is a timber.

clue.text: Sit out with a girl in gauzy fabric

indicators.note: out means the word sit is turned out of its order

parts.note: Sue is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Sit outside with a woman wearing filmy cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' looks like going outdoors, but it is the anagram signal on 'Sit'.
explanation.definitionFit: Fine, thin paper or cloth is a delicate gauze-like material.
